title: The Tradition as preserved knowledge chain
statement: The Tradition is the corpus's name for the cross-cultural body of preserved knowledge — cosmic, astronomical, religious, and technical — handed down within esoteric teaching lineages (the shalshelet ha-Kabbalah above all) and traced, on the framework's reading, to instruction originating with the creators; the chain reading connects the canon's closest-to-truth ranking of the Kabbalah (woh-claim-0021) with the encoding claims of the precessional cluster, and its systematization into one named continuum is corpus development at speculative grade.

includes: The chain reading: esoteric transmission lineages read as carriers of originally delivered knowledge, degraded and re-encoded across transmission
The anchor connections: the Kabbalah ranking (woh-claim-0021) as the canon's own pointer at one such lineage; the encoding claims (woh-claim-0014, 0044) as the astronomical strand
The disclosure: 'the Tradition' as a single continuum is the corpus's organizing construct over lineages that understand themselves separately
excludes: Perennialist doctrine; the corpus's chain has a specific proposed origin, not a timeless universal wisdom
Validation of esoteric systems' own metaphysics; each lineage's self-understanding is preserved in its own voice
Initiatory or practical content; the record concerns transmission, not practice
Secret-history causation claims (lineages steering events), which the corpus does not make

source_references.locator: TBWTT-5:51-54 (the Kabbalah ranking; the traditions testifying) — the canon's pointers the chain reading builds from
The scholarly account of the Kabbalistic transmission chain the corpus's construct rides on

alternatives.statement: The construct mirrors perennialist historiography with the origin swapped; it inherits perennialism's evidential problems wholesale.
The lineages are historically independent developments; a single continuum is imposed, not found.
A chain whose content degrades across transmission can absorb any counter-evidence as degradation; the reading is unfalsifiable as framed.

revision_triggers: Claim woh-claim-0001 or woh-claim-0021 is revised or retired.
Lineage-level historical work shows a claimed link cannot carry transmission.
Public prose begins validating esoteric metaphysics or asserting secret-history causation, both of which this record excludes.
